pages.text: Above Curved Space and far below the Infinite, islands of $(item)Dense Stone$() in three bands, the same shapes at three sizes: between any two points, another.

$(thing)Fourier Harps$() are rows of 33 rods whose heights add up the first few harmonics of a square wave, overshoot and all. Near one you meet $(thing)Limits$(): the closer you get, the slower you go. You can reach it, but only just.
$(item)Fourier Wisps$() are chains of turning circles drawing a square wave in the air. They keep their distance.

$(item)Epsilon Ore$() gives $(item)Epsilon Dust$(). On the Analytic Continuator: two Real Continua from eight Rational Fields and four dust; four Infinitesimals from a Real Continuum and two dust; a Transcendental Crystal from 32 Dense Stone and four Rational Fields; and eight Dense Stone from eight cobblestone and a dust.
